findings.fsdQuote: The On Deck row shows up to 50 series.
findings.note: The dashboard On Deck row requests page 1 with a page size of 20, not 50.

findings.fsdQuote: A new password must be at least 8 characters long.
findings.note: The code requires only 6 characters, both in the client forms and in the server identity options.

findings.fsdQuote: When Prompt on Download is on, Kavita asks for confirmation before any download larger than 500 MB.
findings.note: The download size warning threshold is 100 MB (104,857,600 bytes), not 500 MB.

findings.fsdQuote: Changes on this page are stored only when the administrator presses Save.
findings.note: The General page saves automatically: a debounced subscription on the form model pushes valid changes to the server, with no Save button step.

findings.fsdQuote: A maintenance mode switch blocks all non-admin users from signing in until it is turned off.
findings.note: No maintenance mode setting or switch exists; 'maintenance' only appears as the nightly maintenance task in the server controller.

findings.fsdQuote: Manage Collections is turned on by default for a new library.
findings.note: The new library form defaults manageCollections to false.

findings.fsdQuote: Include in Dashboard and Include in Search are turned on by default.
findings.note: The new library form defaults includeInDashboard and includeInSearch to true.

findings.fsdQuote: Each type starts with its own file types:
findings.note: Default file types per library type match the table (Manga archive+image, Comic/ComicVine archive, Book pdf+epub, Light Novel epub, Image image).

findings.fsdQuote: Days of Backups and Days of Logs each accept a value from 1 to 30 and both default to 30.
findings.note: Form validation and the server both limit both values to 1-30, and both are seeded with 30.

findings.fsdQuote: Cache Size must be at least 50 MB
findings.note: The form requires cacheSize to be at least 50.

findings.fsdQuote: the base URL must start and end with a slash.
findings.note: The base URL field must match a pattern that begins and ends with a slash.

findings.fsdQuote: A Reset to Default button restores these settings after a confirmation.
findings.note: Reset to defaults asks for confirmation, then calls the server reset and reloads the form.

findings.fsdQuote: Selected text can be read aloud using the device's text-to-speech voice.
findings.note: No speech synthesis or text-to-speech code was found in the book reader.
